title: Guardians add left-handed pop with Nathaniel Lowe, Reds get raw prospect: MLB trade grades
content:
The Athletic has live coverage of the 2026 MLB Trade Deadline.

Cleveland Guardians get: 1B Nathaniel Lowe
Cincinnati Reds get: RHP Alejandro Rivera

Guardians: C+
Reds: B-

The Guardians have the lowest OPS in baseball. Is a left-handed, platoon first baseman going to fix that? Between Lowe and right-handed addition Jo Adell, the Guardians basically added one good hitter at the deadline. Each can be productive in a platoon, but each is stretched in an everyday role. Lowe could be the third first baseman on the roster — along with Kyle Manzardo and Rhys Hoskins — but those two have significantly underperformed, and Lowe at least crushes righties. It’s a nice addition, even if it feels like another half-hearted attempt to address an ongoing offensive problem.

As for the Reds, they turned one solid year of Lowe into a lottery ticket. Rivera is a 19-year-old with good numbers and a long, long way to go.

— Chad Jennings
